events.title: 황해도 해주에서 태어나다
events.description: 황해도 해주 텃골의 가난한 농가에서 태어났다. 어릴 때 이름은 창암이었다.
events.description_en: He was born into a poor farming family in Tteotgol, Haeju, Hwanghae Province. His childhood name was Changam.

events.title: 동학 접주로 해주성을 공격하다
events.title_en: He led Donghak forces in an attack on Haeju
events.description: 동학에 들어가 접주가 되어 농민군을 이끌었다. 해주성을 공격했으나 관군에 밀려 패했다.
events.description_en: He joined the Donghak movement and became a local leader commanding peasant forces. He led an attack on Haeju fortress but was driven back and defeated by government troops.

events.title: 치하포에서 일본인을 죽이다
events.title_en: He killed a Japanese man at Chihapo
events.description: 명성황후 시해에 대한 복수라며 치하포에서 일본인 상인 스치다 조스케를 죽였다. 이 일로 해주에서 붙잡혀 사형을 선고받았다.
events.description_en: Calling it revenge for the assassination of Empress Myeongseong, he killed a Japanese merchant, Tsuchida Joshuke, at Chihapo. He was arrested in Haeju and sentenced to death.

events.title: 사형 집행 직전에 특사로 살아남다
events.title_en: His execution was halted at the last moment
events.description: 인천 감리서에서 사형 집행을 기다리던 중 고종의 특사로 형이 멈췄다. 사형장으로 끌려가기 직전이었다.
events.description_en: While awaiting execution at the Incheon magistrate's prison, King Gojong's special pardon halted the sentence. It came just before he was to be taken to the gallows.

events.title: 인천 감옥에서 탈옥하다
events.description: 복역 중이던 인천 감옥에서 탈옥해 몸을 숨겼다. 이후 이름과 신분을 숨긴 채 전국을 떠돌았다.
events.description_en: He escaped from the Incheon prison where he was serving his sentence and went into hiding. He wandered the country afterward, concealing his name and identity.

events.title: 안명근 사건에 연루되어 옥고를 치르다
events.title_en: He was imprisoned over the An Myeong-geun case
events.description: 신민회 활동 중 안명근 사건에 얽혀 붙잡혀 15년형을 선고받고 서대문형무소에 갇혔다. 이때 이름을 구(九)로, 호를 백범으로 고쳤다.
events.description_en: While active in the Sinminhoe society, he was arrested over the An Myeong-geun case and sentenced to fifteen years at Seodaemun Prison. There he changed his given name to Gu and took the pen name Baekbeom.

events.title: 상하이로 가 임시정부에 합류하다
events.title_en: He went to Shanghai and joined the Provisional Government
events.description: 3.1운동 뒤 상하이로 망명해 대한민국 임시정부에 합류했다. 경무국장을 시작으로 임시정부 요직을 두루 거쳤다.
events.description_en: After the March First Movement he fled to Shanghai and joined the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea. He rose through its ranks, starting as chief of police.

events.title: 한인애국단을 조직하다
events.title_en: He founded the Korean Patriotic Organization
events.description: 임시정부 재정이 바닥나던 시기에 한인애국단을 조직해 의열 투쟁을 이끌었다.
events.description_en: As the Provisional Government's finances ran dry, he organized the Korean Patriotic Organization to lead armed resistance actions.

events.title: 이봉창을 도쿄로 보내 일왕을 저격하게 하다
events.title_en: He sent Yi Bong-chang to Tokyo to attack the emperor
events.description: 한인애국단원 이봉창을 도쿄로 보내 일왕의 행렬에 폭탄을 던지게 했다. 명중하지 못했으나 일본 사회에 큰 충격을 주었다.
events.description_en: He sent Yi Bong-chang, a member of the Korean Patriotic Organization, to Tokyo to throw a bomb at the emperor's procession. The bomb missed its mark, but the attempt shook Japanese society.

events.title: 윤봉길을 훙커우 공원으로 보내다
events.title_en: He sent Yun Bong-gil to Hongkou Park
events.description: 윤봉길을 상하이 훙커우 공원의 일왕 생일 행사장으로 보내 폭탄을 던지게 했다. 일본군 고위 장성들이 이 자리에서 죽거나 다쳤다.
events.description_en: He sent Yun Bong-gil to throw a bomb at a ceremony for the emperor's birthday in Hongkou Park, Shanghai. Several senior Japanese generals were killed or wounded there.

events.title: 충칭 임시정부의 주석이 되다
events.title_en: He became chairman of the Provisional Government in Chongqing
events.description: 일본군을 피해 여러 도시를 옮겨 다니던 임시정부가 충칭에 자리 잡자 그 주석에 올랐다. 광복 때까지 이 자리를 지켰다.
events.description_en: When the Provisional Government, having moved from city to city to escape the Japanese army, finally settled in Chongqing, he became its chairman. He held the post until liberation.

events.title: 광복을 맞아 고국으로 돌아오다
events.description: 일본이 패망하자 임시정부 요인들과 함께 개인 자격으로 귀국했다. 27년 만의 귀국이었다.
events.description_en: When Japan surrendered, he returned home with the other leaders of the Provisional Government, though only in a private capacity. It was his first time back in twenty-seven years.

events.title: 분단을 막으려 평양으로 가다
events.title_en: He went to Pyongyang to try to stop division
events.description: 남한만의 단독정부 수립에 반대해 김규식과 함께 평양으로 가 북측 지도자들과 남북협상을 벌였다. 성과 없이 끝났지만 분단에 끝까지 저항한 행보로 남았다.
events.description_en: Opposing the creation of a separate government in the South alone, he traveled to Pyongyang with Kim Gyu-sik to hold North-South negotiations with the North's leaders. The talks produced no result, but the trip stood as his last stand against division.

events.title: 경교장에서 총에 맞아 죽다
events.title_en: He was shot dead at Gyeonggyojang
events.description: 서울 경교장 자택에서 육군 소위 안두희의 총에 맞아 숨졌다. 일흔둘이었다.
events.description_en: He was shot and killed by army lieutenant An Du-hui at his Seoul residence, Gyeonggyojang. He was seventy-two.
